title: Empirical mean of a Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. The average, over all inputs $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, of $f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
